issues.problem: EN adds a summary sentence not present in ZH: "Eighteen hundred miles, the Pole, a base on the far side of the continent." The facts echo the quoted plan (which ZH already gives), but the sentence itself has no counterpart in the Chinese text.
issues.suggestion: Either add a short echo in ZH (e.g. 「一千八百英里，极点，大陆另一侧的基地」) or drop the sentence from EN.

issues.problem: EN specifies the hope as "leads opening nearby, boats in the water, land to the north-west"; ZH only says 「附近可能开出水道，那时可以划船去找陆地」 and omits the direction (north-west), which both languages give in sections.story.8.
issues.suggestion: Change ZH to 「那时可以划船向西北去找陆地」 (or remove "to the north-west" from EN).

overall: The two editions match on all facts, figures, quotations and attributions; only two minor wording gaps remain — an EN-only echo sentence and an omitted direction in ZH.
